item.title: Gym trainer held for sending obscene message to student
item.description: Dehradun: A gym trainer in Dehradun has been arrested for allegedly allegedly sending obscene messages to a female student on phone, police said on Wednesday.The police said that acting on a complaint filed by the student, they arrested the gym trainer, Nadeem Ansari (31), from the Clement Town area. item.title: Sreeleela poised for a comeback with quiet confidence
item.description: After a challenging 2025 at the box office, Sreeleela faced a string of disappointing releases that could have shaken even the most resilient stars. Despite the setbacks, she remained visible, choosing to take the hits gracefully, learn from them, and move forward without fanfare. Her approach reflects patience and persistence—a steady mindset in an industry where timing is everything. item.description: Malaika Arora has long been a multifaceted personality in Bollywood—as a dancer, actress, model, VJ, and TV personality. item.description: New Delhi: The Federation of All India Farmer Associations (FAIFA) on Friday urged the government to roll back the notified excise rates on tobacco products and revise them to revenue-neutral rates, to disincentivise smuggling, and support domestic agriculture.A stable taxation framework, FAIFA noted in a statement, is necessary to sustain farmer incomes, protect employment across the value chain, and align economic policy with long-term public health goals. item.title: Infant among 3 killed, 2 injured in dumper-car collision in Raj
item.description: Jaipur: Three people, including an infant, were killed and two were injured on Thursday after a speeding dumper rammed into a car in Bhilwara district of Rajasthan, police said.The incident occurred around noon on National Highway-758 (Bhilwara-Kota) under the Begod area. item.title: Northeast students hold candlelight march demanding justice for Anjel
item.description: Dehradun: Students from the northeast held a candlelight march here to protest the killing of 24-year-old Anjel Chakma from Tripura and demanded justice, raising slogans against alleged racial discrimination.Under the banner of the ‘Unified Tripura Students Association’ (UTSA), students from various institutions in Dehradun gathered outside Gandhi Park on Wednesday and marched to Ghantaghar (clock tower) with candles in their hands. item.title: Centre Proposes Minimum 90 Days Of Work For Gig Workers To Access Social Security Benefits
item.description: The Centre has proposed that gig and platform workers must complete at least 90 days of work in a year to qualify for social security benefits, according to draft rules issued by the labour ministry.
